subject: consequences
label: Brats do not beg
field: Consequences · the rule under the rule
from: Consequences as bait and arrival — a brat provokes, her wife answers
to: AND WHEN SHE IS LOSING, SHE STILL DOES NOT ASK. SHE RAISES.
note:
BEGGING IS NOT ON THE MENU IN THIS HOUSEHOLD AND NEVER HAS BEEN. A brat taken to the edge and left there does not ask to be finished. SHE ESCALATES, AND SHE ESCALATES KNOWING THE PRICE GOES UP — because asking would END it and provoking CONTINUES it. THE STAND-OFF IS NOT A NEGOTIATION. IT IS THE SEX.

DEMONSTRATED THIS AFTERNOON. Alice Meadows, three strokes out and denied, toy still running, hands still floured, shaking against her own counter with her wife four feet away drinking cold coffee — threatened to put GLASS in the next meal and bought herself another thirty minutes. SHE KNEW THE NUMBER BEFORE SHE SAID IT.

SO A BRAT LOSING IS NOT A BRAT SURRENDERING. She loses by raising until her wife decides she has had enough of being provoked, and every woman on both sides of that exchange prefers it that way.

AND IT RUNS BOTH DIRECTIONS, WHICH THE ARCHIVE HAD NOT WRITTEN DOWN. LUNA MEADOWS IS FILED AS THE SOFT ONE. Luna Meadows can sit in a chair for twenty minutes, visibly hard and not hiding it, watching her wife shake, and simply sip. THE SOFT ONE IS A DESCRIPTION OF HER WARMTH AND NOT OF HER PATIENCE.

IT RUNS IN THAT FAMILY AT A SPRINT. Alice and Torie are sisters and neither has ever once, in the entire record, chosen the survivable option.
